SM2 key agreement still has no independent implementation cross-check.
Even with suite 2 live, this is not a post-quantum system: SM2 identity authentication is not post-quantum.

recorded_limitations: Reuse of an ML-KEM encapsulation key across sessions is not detectable by the responder; only degenerate cases such as an all-zero key are caught.
Key destruction is best effort, not secure erasure.
Operation_id idempotency holds within a session; exactly-once across process restarts is NOT IMPLEMENTED and no database was introduced.
Resource limits bound growth; they are not a denial-of-service defence.
Revocation is observed on a polling interval (250ms by default), not pushed instantly.
may_proceed_note: M4 functionality is complete and the two verification gaps are carried forward. They must be closed before any deployment or any claim of complete verification.
